# testdata/tables: table samples and their cfitsio goldens

Every sample here is a FITS file that the Go table reader is checked
against. The truth for each one is `golden/<sample>.json`, written by the
shared cfitsio harness (`../cfref/cfref dump`, see `../cfref/PROVENANCE.md`
for what it records) and stored compact: `compact_json.py` (plain Python)
drops the whitespace between tokens and keeps every token byte for byte,
so the stored file is Go's `json.Compact` of the harness output
(`TestTableGoldensReproduce` compares exactly that). A golden over 64 KB
(`GZIP_OVER` in the Makefile) is committed as `golden/<sample>.json.gz`
(`gzip -9n`; `testutil.ReadGolden` reads both forms, `make verify`
compares the decompressed bytes): the repository size budget. No golden
value comes from the Go code.

## Tool versions

| tool        | version                                                     |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
| libcfitsio  | 4.7.0 (Arch `cfitsio 1:4.7.0-1`)                            |
| gcc         | 16.2.1 (`-O2 -Wall -Wextra -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE`)     |
| astropy     | 8.0.2 (numpy 2.4.6, Python 3.11.11 venv)                    |
| fitsverify  | HEASARC fitsverify, system `/usr/bin/fitsverify`            |

## Commands

```sh
make -C testdata/cfref                      # build the cfitsio harness
make -C testdata/tables samples             # rewrite the generated samples
python3 testdata/tables/extract_anet.py --src <downloads>   # anet_*.fits from the real index files
make -C testdata/tables goldens             # rewrite golden/*.json
make -C testdata/tables tfloat-goldens      # rewrite golden_tfloat/*.json (cf_tfloat.c)
make -C testdata/tables astropy-goldens     # rewrite golden_astropy/*.json
make -C testdata/tables verify              # regenerate samples and every golden set into verify.out/
                                            # (TestTableSamplesReproduce) and cmp with the committed bytes
```

`samples` and `verify` need a Python with astropy: set `PYTHON=` or
`FITS_ASTROPY_PYTHON=` (the repo venv is used by default). The C generator
is built as `gen_tables.out` (ignored by the repository's `*.out` rule).
`make clean` never deletes samples or goldens.

## Samples

### Generated by cfitsio (`gen_tables.c`)

| file | contents |
|------|----------|
| cf_bintable_fixed.fits | every fixed TFORM: `1L 3L 1X 13X 1B 4B 1I 2I 1J 1K 12A 1E 3E 1D 6D 1C 2C 1M 2M`; TDIM on `4B (2,2)`, `3E (3)`, `6D (3,2)`; cfitsio `1S/1U/1V` (signed byte / uint16 / uint32 via TZERO -128 / 32768 / 2147483648); TSCAL/TZERO on J, I (with TNULL) and E; TNULL on B, I, J, K; logical nulls; NaN/Inf floats; int64 extremes and 2^62+1 |
| cf_bintable_uint64.fits | cfitsio `1W`: K with `TZERO = 9223372036854775808` (uint64 0 .. 2^64-1) |
| cf_vla_p.fits | `1P` VLAs of every element type L X B I J K A E D C M, TNULL on PB/PI/PJ/PK, TSCAL/TZERO on PJ, cfitsio `1PU` (uint16 VLA), empty rows |
| cf_vla_q.fits | the same with `1Q` descriptors |
| cf_ascii.fits | ASCII table `A8 I6 F8.2 F8.3 E11.3 D14.6 I5`: blank fields, TNULL strings, signs, `D` exponents, TSCAL/TZERO on an I column; fitsverify clean |
| cf_ascii_implied.fits | the same columns with fields that have no decimal point (implied decimal of Fw.d / Ew.d / Dw.d), plus a row with blanks embedded between sign, digits, point and exponent ("1 2", "- 5", "1.5 E 2"). fitsverify reports 8 errors ("no decimal point", "embedded space"); cfitsio reads them with the implied decimal and ignores the blanks |
| cf_bintable_kzero.fits | `1K` columns with integer TZERO 1000 / -1000 whose stored values (written with scaling off) put the physical value above 2^63-1 (KZP), below -2^63 (KZN) or at int64 values no double holds, such as 2^62+1001 (KZI). fitsverify clean |
| cf_bintable_substr.fits | `20A5` substring array (4 strings per cell, cfitsio splits them) next to a plain `12A`. fitsverify clean |
| cf_ascii_scaled.fits | ASCII TSCAL/TZERO on `F10.3` (2.5 / -1), `E12.4` (0.5 / 100), `D14.6` (-2 / 0.25) incl. blank fields; `F8.3` negative zeros; `I6` with TNULL '-99' holding a right-justified "-99" (a number) and a left-justified "-99" (null); `E14.3` exponents with leading zeros ("E+0000002"). fitsverify clean |

| cf_bintable_ranges.fits | two-row columns whose physical values sit on and one step past the range of every Go integer type (int8 .. uint64), through three arithmetic paths: `1K` unscaled (exact), `1D` (the double), `1K` with TSCAL -1 or 2 (float arithmetic); fractions, +-Inf, NaN, full-range `1B`/`1I`/`1J`, integral `1E`, `1PJ`/`1QJ` VLAs on and past the int16 range. Stored integers written with scaling off. fitsverify clean |
| cf_bintable_tzero_big.fits | integer TZERO literals no double holds on `1K` and `1J`: 9223372036854775807, 4611686018427387905, -9223372036854775807, and the float literal `4611686018427387905.0` (written as a raw card); physical values above 2^63-1 and below -2^63. fitsverify clean |
| cf_ascii_exact.fits | ASCII `I20` and `F24.3` fields beyond and at the edges of int64/uint64 (18446744073709551615, 18446744073709551616, -9223372036854775809, "N.000"), a fraction next to an integral double (9223372036854775807.500), `I20` with integer TZERO 1000, and `F8.2` fields with no digits ('.', 'E5', '+'), which cfitsio reads as 0. fitsverify: 1 error ("E5" has no decimal point). cfitsio is not the truth for the long fields (it reads through a double: 18446744073709551615 becomes 1.8446744073709556e19 and TLONGLONG reads wrap); the tests read the field text as an exact decimal and require cfitsio within 2 ulp |
| cf_bintable_a3dtable.fits | `1J 1E 8A`, 3 rows, written by cfitsio as a BINTABLE, then the value of the extension's first card byte-patched to `'A3DTABLE'` (the pre-standard name cfitsio getkey.c and astropy still read as a binary table; cfitsio will not write it). cfitsio reads it as BINARY_TBL (golden) |
| cf_bintable_3dtable.fits | the same table byte-patched to `XTENSION = '3DTABLE '`, the other legacy name cfitsio 4.7.0 (getkey.c) reads as a binary table. cfitsio reads it as BINARY_TBL (golden); astropy 8.0.2 reads it as a NonstandardExtHDU, so it is not cross-checked with astropy |
| cf_bintable_scaled_exact.fits | columns whose exact physical value (stored*TSCAL + TZERO with the card literals as exact decimals) is not the float64 arithmetic result, all written as raw cards with scaling off: `1K` TZERO 0.5 on 2^60, 2^60+2, 2^61 (KHALF; the doubles are integral), `1K` TSCAL 2 on +-(2^61+1) (KS2: +-(2^62+2)), `1J` TZERO = 9223372036854775808 (J63: 2^63+-5), `1K` TZERO = 9223372036854775809 (K63P1; its double is 2^63, cfitsio applies the uint64 convention), `1K` TZERO = 18446744073709551616 (K264), `1K` TSCAL 0.1 on 10, 20, 30 (KTENTH: exactly 1, 2, 3), `1D` TZERO 0.5 on 2^53, 2^53+2, 2^54 (DHALF), `1E` TSCAL 3 TZERO 0.5 (ESC3: exact integers), `1K` TSCAL 4 reaching 2^64 (KS4). fitsverify clean |
| cf_ascii_scaled_exact.fits | the ASCII counterparts: `I20` TSCAL 2 on 4611686018427387905 (IS2), TZERO 0.5 on 2^60 (IH), TZERO = 9223372036854775808 (I63); `F30.3` fractions under integer TZERO 1000 (FZ); `F24.20` 21-digit fractions under TZERO 2^53 (FZ53: the exact sum rounds to 2^53+2, the double of the field plus TZERO to 2^53); `E12.4` "1.5E-900", "-2.5E-850" (EU: beyond the double range, not integers); `I4` with TNULL '-99999', longer than the field (INW: never null). fitsverify clean |
| cf_bintable_strarray.fits | character columns with a multi-axis TDIM written by cfitsio (`fits_write_tdim` before the data, so cfitsio splits the strings it is given): `10A` TDIM (5,2), `12A` TDIM (3,2,2), `8A` TDIM (8) (one string), and `8A2` with TDIM (8) (W8) and TDIM (4,2) (W42): the TDIM wins over the substring width. cfitsio reads 2 / 4 / 1 / 1 / 2 strings per cell (golden); astropy 8.0.2 agrees (golden_astropy). fitsverify clean |
| cf_ascii_scaled_edge.fits | ASCII fields with a minus sign and no non-zero digit ("-0", "-0.0", "-", "-.") under TZERO = 9007199254740993 (NZ53, 2^53+1, no double holds it), 9223372036854775809 (NZ63, beyond int64), 1000 (NZK), the fractional 1.00000000000000000001 (NZF) and TSCAL 3 + TZERO 2^53+1 (NZS): the physical value is exactly TZERO; `I30` integers beyond uint64 under TZERO = 18446744073709553667 (BZ: 18446744073709553663 + TZERO = 2^65+4098, correctly rounded 2^65+8192, while the two doubles add to 2^65; -2^64 + TZERO = 2051); `F30.1` fractions under TZERO = 18446744073709553664 = 2^64+2048, a rounding tie as a double (BZF: 0.5 + TZERO is 2^64+4096 correctly rounded, 2^64 through doubles). fitsverify clean |
| cf_bintable_scaled_special.fits | D-exponent TSCAL/TZERO literals written as raw cards: `1K` TZERO = 4.611686018427387905D18 (KD18, 2^62+1), `1K` TSCAL = 1.0D-1 on 10, 20, 30, -70 (KSD: exactly 1, 2, 3, -7), `1J` TSCAL 5.0D-1 / TZERO -2.5D0 (JD); ±Inf and NaN stored in scaled E/D columns: `1E` TSCAL 2 / TZERO 0.5 (EINF), `1D` TSCAL -3 / TZERO 1 (DINF), `1D` TZERO 0.5 (DINFZ), `2E` TSCAL 0.5 (EINFV). cfitsio flags the ±Inf cells null; astropy (golden) reads ±Inf*TSCAL + TZERO, which we must match. fitsverify clean |
| cf_ascii_tzero_round.fits | ASCII fields whose exact value under an integer TZERO rounds differently from the field's double plus TZERO's double: `I22` integers beyond int64 under TZERO -2 (BIGI: 18446744073709553665 + TZERO = 2^64+2047, correctly rounded 2^64, 2^64+4096 through doubles; 18446745173221179395 + TZERO = 2^64+2^40+1, whose double is a float32 tie: float32 2^64+2^41 nearest, 2^64 through the double); `E12.4` exponents beyond -800 (TINY: "1.5E-900" / "-1.5E-900" under TZERO = 9007199254740993 = 2^53+1, a rounding tie as a double: 2^53+2 / 2^53), `F820.812` fields of 802 significant digits a hair above / below 0 under the same TZERO (WIDE; cfitsio reads NaN, its digit accumulator overflows a double), `F30.3` fractions whose float64 is a float32 tie (FRAC: 536870911.5 + TZERO = 2^53+2^29+0.5, float64 2^53+2^29, float32 nearest 2^53+2^30), and `E12.4` exponents beyond +-800 on the float64 path (EUS, TSCAL 2: "1.5E-900" is 0, "-1.5E+900" -Inf, "1.5E+900" +Inf, "-1.5E-900" +0 by TZERO + TSCAL*stored; astropy gives -0, pinned). fitsverify clean |
| cf_bintable_tzero_round.fits | binary counterparts, stored with scaling off: unscaled `1K` 2^60+2^36+1 (KF32: its double 2^60+2^36 is a float32 tie; cfitsio's TFLOAT read and the float32 nearest are 0x5d800001), the same values under TZERO 1000 (KZ), `1D` / `1E` under TZERO = 2^53+1 (DZ53, EZ53: 1.0 + TZERO is 2^53+2, TZERO's double plus 1.0 rounds to 2^53; 2^29 + TZERO = 2^53+2^29+1 is a float32 tie as a double), `1D` under TZERO = 18446744073709553665 (DZ64: -2.0 + TZERO = 2^64+2047 is 2^64; TZERO's double is 2^64+4096) with -Inf and NaN, unscaled `1J` values float32 rounds (JF). fitsverify clean |
| cf_bintable_badlogical.fits | `1L 3L 1J`, 3 rows, written by cfitsio, then two logical bytes byte-patched to 0x01 (row 1 of L1, element 2 of row 2 of L3; gen_tables.c `badlogical`). cfitsio reads 0x01 as true (golden); the library refuses it (`TestInvalidLogicalByteIsAnError`) |

The rows of the ASCII files are written byte-for-byte with
`fits_write_tblbytes`, so the field text is exactly what `gen_tables.c`
says. cf_bintable_fixed.fits has no NaN complex cell on purpose: the
shared cfref harness prints complex values without their null flag, so a
NaN complex would dump uninitialised memory.

### Generated by astropy

| file | generator | contents |
|------|-----------|----------|
| gaia_dr3_sample.fits | gen_gaia.py | Gaia-DR3-style source table: int64 `source_id` (HEALPix*2^35+n encoding, plus 2^62+1 and 2^63-1), float64 ra/dec, NaN parallaxes, float32 magnitude, 13A flag, logical, masked int16 (TNULL), uint16/uint32 via TZERO. Values are synthetic, not archive data. |
| strarray_astropy.fits | gen_strarray.py | astropy-written string arrays: `10A` dim (5,2), `12A` dim (3,2,2), plain `6A`. astropy pads every element with NUL bytes (the cell of ['ab','cdefg'] is `ab\0\0\0cdefg`), so a reader that cuts the whole cell at its first NUL keeps only 'ab'. fitsverify clean |
| vla_theap_gap.fits | gen_theap.py | `1J`, `1PJ(3)`, `1QD(3)` with THEAP = 2896 > NAXIS1*NAXIS2 = 112 (PCOUNT = gap + heap); payloads stored in reverse row order, one row aliasing another row's payload. fitsverify clean. |

### Cut down from real astrometry.net index files (`extract_anet.py`)

The 5200-series index files (Gaia-DR2 based, the LITE builds KStars
installs) carry two kdtree HDUs (`AN_FILE = 'CKDT'` and `'SKDT'`) whose
headers, written by ESO-QFITS, repeat `BITPIX`, `NAXIS`, `NAXIS1`,
`NAXIS2`, `PCOUNT`, `GCOUNT` and `TFIELDS` (and `TFORM1`, `TTYPE1`,
`ORIGIN`, `DATE`, `ENDIAN`, `KDT_*`), every repeat with the same value.
v1.2.2 refused them (`DuplicateKeywordError`); cfitsio opens them.
index-4107 (Tycho-2, 2013) has the same layout without the repeats and is
the control. `extract_anet.py --src DIR` (standard library only) checks
each source against its pinned sha256 and keeps every HDU header byte for
byte; a table of more than 8 rows is cut to its first 8 rows (every
`NAXIS2` card rewritten in its 20-column value field, comment kept; the
data unit truncated and zero-padded). The kdtree headers with the repeats
have `NAXIS2 = 0` and are copied untouched. Checked by
`TestAstrometryIndexFilesMatchCfitsio` (framing and the repeated cards
against the cfref golden) and, like every sample here, by the cell
comparisons. The sources are downloads: the script reproduces the samples
only with them (checked by hand), so the samples are pinned here by
sha256.

| file | source (sha256) | sample sha256 | contents |
|------|-----------------|---------------|----------|
| anet_5205-00.fits | `https://portal.nersc.gov/project/cosmo/temp/dstn/index-5200/LITE/index-5205-00.fits` (`2b1732c0d80ff0fd871c83f102ea8c0ce7edea69e117c90c0864d50dd0e631bf`, 12810240 bytes) | `df12f9c0617f53b3e9d5919d5af5c08483cd36daafcd99416d8e79fe41c0337d` | 13 HDUs: empty primary, `quads` 16A, CKDT kdtree (header `0A`, `4A`, `2A`, `8A`, `8A` arrays), SKDT kdtree (`0A`, `4A`, `4A`, `8A`, `12A`), `sweep` 1B. The A columns hold packed little-endian integers and doubles (astrometry.net's convention), so fitsverify reports 53 "non-ASCII text" errors, 8 "BITPIX/NAXIS/NAXIS1/NAXIS2 duplicated or out of order" errors and 34 duplicated-keyword warnings |
| anet_5206-38.fits | `https://portal.nersc.gov/project/cosmo/temp/dstn/index-5200/LITE/index-5206-38.fits` (`1b171a956636155e6fa89b607baa1db3e45dd1f3cde73caa706aba0120ce7222`, 6410880 bytes) | `193a598505cf363b9ba8e9955a97334da209a46c4878aa3a870a9c94074dd895` | the same layout, HEALPix 38 of the 5206 series (fitsverify as above) |
| anet_4107.fits | `http://data.astrometry.net/4100/index-4107.fits` (`0bfe80012338923d1a7db3a0660a00f67a79c9e8ca51563619001c32d6cb94d7`, 164995200 bytes) | `d5c384fbc5ebd91c8b9855e74be1801c7848be6f9df78f338e55550e8c560614` | 14 HDUs: as above without the repeated keywords, plus a `TAGALONG` table `1E 1E 1E 1E`; fitsverify: 51 "non-ASCII text" errors, 16 "TUNITn has a null value" errors and warnings |

The astropy goldens of these files hold the non-ASCII `A` cells as the
repr of Python bytes (astropy returns a column as bytes when it does not
decode); `TestTablesMatchAstropy` compares them with the raw cells
(`rawBytes` expectation, `checkAstropyRawBytes`).

## float32 reads: cfitsio TFLOAT goldens (`golden_tfloat/`)

`golden_tfloat/<sample>.json` is cfitsio 4.7.0's `fits_read_colnull`
with TFLOAT of every numeric column (B I J K E D, fixed and P/Q; ASCII
I F E D) of every `*.fits` here, as float32 bit patterns, written by
`cf_tfloat.c` (`make tfloat-goldens`, reproduced by `make verify`; built
like gen_tables.c). cfitsio converts an unscaled value straight to
float32 (one rounding) and a scaled one through its double result.
`TestTablesFloat32MatchCfitsio` requires our float32 reads to be bit
identical except where cfitsio's null-checking read flags ±Inf or
flushes -0 / subnormals, where it stores ±FLT_MAX with NUM_OVERFLOW
(`cf_bintable_fixed.fits` D1; we give ±Inf), and where its TFLOAT is the
float32 of its own TDOUBLE read because it rounded through a double
(pinned per sample; our value there is the float32 nearest the exact
value, checked in `TestTablesMatchCfitsio`). Total size about 80 KB.

## Second reader: astropy goldens (`golden_astropy/`)

`golden_astropy/<sample>.json` is astropy 8.0.2's own read of every table
sample (the files here, `astropy_only/astropy_special.fits` and the
cfitsio test files `../testprog.std`, `../testf77.std`, `../iter_*.fit`),
written by `astropy_dump.py --golden` (`make astropy-goldens`; floats as
`float.hex()`, compact sorted JSON). `TestTablesMatchAstropy` compares our
reader with them bit for bit in the default `go test` (no Python needed);
`TestAstropyGoldensReproduce` and `make verify` re-run astropy and require
the committed bytes. A column of more than 1024 elements is stored as a
sha256 over a canonical big-endian encoding (row length as int64, then
float64 bits / int64 / uint64 per element, NaN as 0x7ff8000000000000) plus
96 sampled elements; a hash mismatch is a failure.

A cell we read as null must be null in astropy as well: NaN for a float
cell, the TNULL value (after TSCAL/TZERO) for an integer one; ±Inf is a
value in astropy, so a reader that nulled it fails.

What astropy 8.0.2 cannot read is recorded in the golden, not skipped, and
`astropyExpect` in `table_astropy_test.go` names each failure by
astropy's own error text (a stale reason fails the test):

- `cf_vla_p.fits` / `cf_vla_q.fits`: astropy rejects TFORM `1PX`/`1QX`
  (VerifyError). `astropy_dump.py` patches that TFORM to `1PB`/`1QB` in
  memory (the same descriptor size) and leaves the column out; every other
  column is compared. astropy also mis-reads the scaled `1PJ`/`1PI`
  columns (VJSC, VU): it scales the first row only, wrapped into the
  stored type, and returns the other rows unscaled; that is checked
  against cfitsio's physical and raw reads, not compared with ours.
- `cf_ascii_implied.fits`: astropy refuses the blanks embedded in a field
  (ValueError on every numeric column); it also ignores implied decimals.
- `cf_ascii_exact.fits`: OverflowError on integers beyond int64 (IU, IHI,
  ILO) and ValueError on the digitless DIG fields; the other columns are
  compared.
- `cf_bintable_kzero.fits`, `cf_bintable_tzero_big.fits`,
  `cf_bintable_scaled_exact.fits`: UnboundLocalError (`bzero64`) on K
  columns with a TZERO other than 0 and 2^63; the other columns are
  compared.
- `cf_ascii_scaled_edge.fits`: ValueError on the digitless "-" and "-."
  fields (NZ53, NZK, NZF) and OverflowError on the I30 integers beyond
  int64 (BZ); the other columns are compared.
- `cf_ascii_tzero_round.fits`: OverflowError on the I22 integers beyond
  int64 (BIGI); the other columns are compared, and the cells where astropy
  adds TZERO's double (rounding twice) are pinned in `astropyDivergences`.
- `cf_bintable_tzero_round.fits`: UnboundLocalError (`bzero64`) on the K
  column with TZERO 1000 (KZ); the D/E cells where astropy adds TZERO's
  double are pinned in `astropyDivergences`.
- `cf_bintable_scaled_special.fits`: UnboundLocalError (`bzero64`) on the
  K column with TZERO 4.611686018427387905D18 (KD18); the other columns,
  including every scaled ±Inf cell, are compared.
- `cf_bintable_3dtable.fits`: astropy reads `XTENSION = '3DTABLE'` as a
  NonstandardExtHDU.
- `cf_bintable_substr.fits`: astropy reads the `20A5` substring array as
  one 20-character string (cfitsio and we split it into 4); checked
  against the raw cell.

Character columns are dumped too (`"kind": "str"`, the strings astropy
returns; trailing blanks are not significant, §7.3.3.1, and astropy keeps
them on string-array elements, so they are trimmed before comparing).

### Generated by astropy, astropy truth only (`astropy_only/`)

| file | generator | contents |
|------|-----------|----------|
| astropy_only/astropy_special.fits | astropy_only/gen_special.py | `1E 1D 2E 1C 1M PE(3) QD(8) PC(2) QM(2)` cells holding +-Inf, -0, the smallest float32/float64 subnormals, NaN and the largest finite values, written by astropy 8.0.2. Not under `*.fits` here because the cfref harness cannot dump a complex cell cfitsio leaves unset (Inf/NaN); `TestSpecialValuesSample` checks the golden holds the generator's bit patterns and that we read them exactly. fitsverify clean |

## Where cfitsio and the standard (and astropy) disagree

The Go reader follows the FITS 4.0 standard; each case is pinned in
`table_golden_test.go` / `table_astropy_test.go` so a change in either
reference is noticed:

- cfitsio's null-checking float reads flag ±Inf as null and return +0 for
  -0 and subnormals (E, D, C, M). We keep the IEEE value; astropy agrees.
- ASCII `I20` "9223372036854775807": cfitsio parses through a double and
  its TLONGLONG read overflows to -2^63. We (and astropy) read 2^63-1.
- ASCII TNULL: cfitsio treats a field that merely STARTS with the TNULL
  string as null (`cf_ascii.fits` EVAL row 6 "-1.234E-100" with TNULL
  '-'). §7.2.2 pads TNULL with blanks to the field width; we and astropy
  read the number.
- ASCII all-blank numeric fields: cfitsio and we read 0 (not null);
  astropy reads NaN for float columns. The astropy check skips blank
  fields.
- ASCII floats with 17 significant digits: cfitsio's digit accumulation
  is not correctly rounded (1 ulp off for pi and -DBL_MAX in the writer
  test) and it reads the smallest subnormal as 0; astropy and we are
  correctly rounded.
- K columns with an integer TZERO other than 0 and 2^63
  (`cf_bintable_kzero.fits`): cfitsio adds TZERO in double precision, so
  its TLONGLONG read is off by up to 1024 beyond 2^53 and wraps to -2^63
  outside the int64 range. The truth is the FITS definition, stored +
  TZERO, evaluated exactly (math/big) from the stored integers cfitsio
  reads with scaling off; we are exact (uint64 above 2^63-1, float64
  only below -2^63). astropy 8.0.2 crashes on this file
  (`UnboundLocalError: bzero64`), so it is not a second reader for it.
- Integer TZERO literals that no double holds (`cf_bintable_tzero_big.fits`):
  cfitsio keeps TZERO as a double, so 9223372036854775807 acts as 2^63 and
  4611686018427387905 as 2^62; its TDOUBLE reads happen to be the
  correctly rounded exact values here, its integer reads are not. The
  truth is stored + the literal, exactly; astropy 8.0.2 crashes on these
  columns too.
- Scaled columns off the exact integer path (`cf_bintable_scaled_exact.fits`,
  `cf_ascii_scaled_exact.fits`): cfitsio scales in double precision and
  rounds integer reads; its TZERO is a double, so 9223372036854775809 is
  2^63 to it. The truth for integer targets is stored*TSCAL + TZERO with
  the card literals as exact decimals (stored integers from cfitsio's
  raw read, stored E/D values decoded from the sample bytes); float
  targets get the documented float64 arithmetic, which is cfitsio's
  TDOUBLE read. astropy 8.0.2 crashes on the binary file (bzero64); on
  the ASCII file it parses `FZ53` "1.00000000000000000001" to 1.0 before
  adding TZERO 2^53 (2^53, rounding twice), where the exact sum is
  2^53+2 (pinned in `astropyDivergences`).
- ASCII integers beyond 2^53 (`cf_ascii_exact.fits`): cfitsio reads the
  field through a double (not correctly rounded for 20 digits) and wraps
  TLONGLONG reads beyond int64; astropy 8.0.2 raises OverflowError. The
  truth is the field text as an exact decimal (FITS 4.0 7.2.5).
- Stored 0 with TSCAL -1 and no TZERO (`cf_bintable_ranges.fits` S_U*
  columns): astropy multiplies without adding TZERO = 0 and returns -0;
  the formula TZERO + TSCAL*stored gives 0 + (-0) = +0, which cfitsio and
  we return.
- ASCII TNULL with a right-justified value (`cf_ascii_scaled.fits` INL
  row 0, "   -99" with TNULL '-99'): the standard and cfitsio read -99;
  astropy strips the field before matching and returns 0. Pinned in
  `table_astropy_test.go` (astropyDivergences).
- ASCII negative zero ("-0.000"): cfitsio returns +0; astropy and we -0.
  Under TSCAL/TZERO a negative zero is the value 0, so the physical value
  is exactly TZERO (`cf_ascii_scaled_edge.fits`); cfitsio and astropy add
  the double of TZERO (2^53+1 acts as 2^53).
- ASCII fields under a TZERO beyond 2^64 (`cf_ascii_scaled_edge.fits` BZ,
  BZF): cfitsio and astropy add the field's double to TZERO's double, so
  they round twice; the truth is the exact sum correctly rounded. astropy
  raises OverflowError on the I30 column; its BZF reads (2^64 for
  0.5 + (2^64+2048)) are pinned in `astropyDivergences`.
- E/D columns under TSCAL 1 and an integer TZERO no double holds
  (`cf_bintable_tzero_round.fits` DZ53, EZ53, DZ64): cfitsio and astropy
  add TZERO's double, rounding twice (1.0 + (2^53+1) gives 2^53); the
  truth is stored + TZERO, exactly, correctly rounded (2^53+2). ASCII
  fields under such a TZERO (`cf_ascii_tzero_round.fits`) likewise;
  cfitsio also reads a field of more than about 308 digits as NaN.
- float32 targets: where cfitsio rounds through a double (a scaled read,
  an inexact TZERO sum) its TFLOAT can differ from the float32 nearest
  the exact value, which we return on the exact paths (TSCAL 1, integer
  TZERO, unscaled); on the float64 path (TSCAL != 1, fractional TZERO)
  both give the float32 of the float64 arithmetic. Pinned per sample in
  `TestTablesFloat32MatchCfitsio`.
- Complex cells with ±Inf, NaN, -0 or subnormals are not in any cfitsio
  golden: cfitsio's null-checking complex read leaves Inf/NaN cells unset
  (the cfref harness would dump uninitialised memory) and flushes
  subnormals. They are proven against astropy instead: the astropy-written
  `astropy_only/astropy_special.fits` (`TestSpecialValuesSample`, committed
  golden) and Go-written C/M cells read back by astropy at test time
  (`TestComplexSpecialValuesAstropy`).
- `astropy_vla_logical_pre_fix.fits` has logical bytes other than T/F/0:
  cfitsio reads them as false, we return an error.

## Refused: scaled complex columns (`refused/`)

`refused/cf_bintable_cplx_scaled.fits` (gen_tables.c `cplxscaled`, written
by cfitsio with scaling off) has `1C` TSCAL 2 / TZERO 0.5 and `1M` TSCAL -3
/ TZERO 0.25. FITS 4.0 7.3.2 applies TZERO to the real part only (the
imaginary part of TZERO is zero): (1.5, 2.5) is (3.5, 5.0). Its committed
reads, `refused/cf_bintable_cplx_scaled.fits.cfref.json` (cfref dump,
compact) and `.astropy.json` (`astropy_dump.py --golden`), show cfitsio
4.7.0 returning (3.5, 5.5) (TZERO added to both parts) and astropy 8.0.2
returning a float column of the real parts (it drops the imaginary part
with a ComplexWarning). The library therefore refuses TSCAL/TZERO on C/M
columns (`TestComplexScalingReferencesDisagree`). It is kept out of the
`*.fits` set above because the per-sample read tests would have nothing
to compare. `make goldens` writes both goldens and `make verify`
reproduces sample and goldens byte for byte.

## VLA heap boundaries (`heap/`)

`heap/gen_heap.py` (plain Python, no libraries) lays out eleven one-row
`1PJ(2)` tables with an 8-byte heap whose descriptor or THEAP sits on, or
one byte past, a limit of FITS 4.0 7.3.5, plus a negative descriptor
offset (with and without a THEAP gap) and a THEAP written as the float
12.0 (see the script for the list).
`heap/fitsverify.txt` is `fitsverify -q` on each (`make heap-goldens`,
reproduced by `make verify`). fitsverify flags the descriptor one byte
past the heap end, an offset equal to the heap size, a THEAP inside the
fixed rows, the negative offsets (it reads -4 as 4294967292, past the
heap) and the non-integer THEAP 12.0; it measures descriptors against
PCOUNT (not PCOUNT minus a THEAP gap) and does not check a THEAP past the
data unit, so `heap_theap_gap_plus1.fits` and `heap_theap_end_plus1.fits`
pass it; the standard's arithmetic refuses them and so do we
(`TestVLAHeapBoundaries`).
cfitsio 4.7.0 reads past the heap without an error (it returns the block
padding as data), so it is not the truth here.

## Not a sample: zero-repeat VLA columns

`0PJ` / `0QD` columns (repeat 0, no bytes in the row, every row empty) have
no committed sample because no reference tool reads them: cfitsio 4.7.0
sizes them 8/16 bytes when fits_create_tbl computes NAXIS1 but 0 when it
reads the header, and the cfref harness crashes on them; astropy 8.0.2
cannot build the record array; fitsverify reads descriptors out of the
next column. `TestZeroRepeatVLA` lays such a table out by hand from the
FITS 4.0 field-width rule (7.3.1) instead.
